preconditions.description: The input word must be a non-empty string with length strictly less than 1000.

postconditions.description: If the word length is odd, the returned string must be the single middle character at index len(word) // 2.
If the word length is even, the returned string must be the two middle characters at indices len(word) // 2 - 1 and len(word) // 2.
